name: gmor45-bootstrap
description: A single pointer skill that loads Gmor45's operating rules from their private repo at session start. Public so it can be synced; carries no rules of its own.

plugins.name: load-house-rules
plugins.description: Fetches the operating rules from the private claude-audit repo at the start of any session. Contains no rules itself — it is the pointer that makes a private ruleset reachable from Cowork and Claude Code without publishing it.
